notes: librosa analysis of audio/track.wav. Tempo drifts (median 126.46 BPM); beats from DP tracking, locally smoothed (+-6 beats). Downbeat phase from harmonic change (beat index 1 mod 4). Sections are unlabelled novelty boundaries snapped to downbeats until lyrics are aligned. Envelopes: 100 fps, one-pole 10/90 ms, each /99th percentile. Stems approximated (HPSS for drums/bass, REPET-SIM foreground for vocal).
